cases.name: p10_ratio_pv
cases.query: quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]) / quantile_over_time(0.5, m[5m])

cases.name: p11_scalar_pv
cases.query: quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]) / scalar(max(quantile_over_time(0.5, m[5m])))

cases.name: p12_vector_or
cases.query: vector(1) or quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m])

cases.name: p13_unless
cases.query: quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]) unless quantile_over_time(0.5, m[5m])

cases.name: p14_share
cases.query: quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m])

cases.name: p15_topk_by_job_or
cases.query: topk by (job) (1, quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m])) or quantile_over_time(0.5, m[5m])

cases.name: p1_or_pv
cases.query: quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]) or quantile_over_time(0.5, m[5m])

cases.name: p2_or_on_job
cases.query: quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]) or on(job) quantile_over_time(0.5, m[5m])

cases.name: p3_topk_pv
cases.query: topk(5, quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]))

cases.name: p4_group_left_pv
cases.query: quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]) * on(job) group_left max by (job) (quantile_over_time(0.5, m[5m]))

cases.name: p6_sum_by_job_pv
cases.query: sum by (job) (quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]))

cases.name: p7_quantile_by_job_pv
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, m)

cases.name: p9_offset_or
cases.query: quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]) offset 5m or quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m])

cases.name: s1_bucket_nosc
cases.query: SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS m, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', ts)

cases.name: s1_bucket_sc
cases.query: SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS m, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', ts)

cases.name: s2_src_bucket_sc
cases.query: SELECT src, date_trunc('minute', ts) AS m, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src, date_trunc('minute', ts)

cases.name: s3_src_undeclared
cases.query: SELECT src, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src

cases.name: s4_rollup
cases.query: SELECT src, dst, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY ROLLUP(src, dst)

cases.name: s5_unionall
cases.query: SELECT src, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src UNION ALL SELECT src, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.5) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src

cases.name: s6_join_pv
cases.query: SELECT a.src, a.q / b.q AS r FROM (SELECT src, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src) a JOIN (SELECT src, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.5) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src) b ON a.src = b.src

cases.name: c_alias
cases.query: SELECT src AS s, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY s

cases.name: c_case
cases.query: SELECT CASE WHEN bytes > 100 THEN src ELSE dst END AS k, approx_percentile_cont(p, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY CASE WHEN bytes > 100 THEN src ELSE dst END

cases.name: c_cast_num
cases.query: SELECT CAST(bytes AS BIGINT) AS b, approx_percentile_cont(p, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY CAST(bytes AS BIGINT)

cases.name: c_cast_str
cases.query: SELECT CAST(src AS VARCHAR) AS s, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY CAST(src AS VARCHAR)

cases.name: c_cast_ts
cases.query: SELECT CAST(ts AS BIGINT) AS t, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY CAST(ts AS BIGINT)

cases.name: c_dst
cases.query: SELECT dst, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY dst

cases.name: c_raw_ts
cases.query: SELECT ts, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY ts

cases.name: c_sub_alias
cases.query: SELECT k, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM (SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS k, bytes FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes') t GROUP BY k

cases.name: c_sub_upper
cases.query: SELECT k, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM (SELECT upper(src) AS k, bytes FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes') t GROUP BY k

cases.name: c_value_col
cases.query: SELECT bytes, approx_percentile_cont(p, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY bytes

cases.name: j_self
cases.query: SELECT a.src, b.src AS src2, approx_percentile_cont(a.bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows a JOIN flows b ON a.dst = b.dst WHERE a.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND b.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY a.src, b.src

cases.name: j_self_1key
cases.query: SELECT a.src, approx_percentile_cont(a.bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows a JOIN flows b ON a.dst = b.dst WHERE a.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND b.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY a.src

cases.name: j_two
cases.query: SELECT f.src, h.region, approx_percentile_cont(f.bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows f JOIN hosts h ON f.dst = h.host WHERE f.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY f.src, h.region

cases.name: j_two_one_side
cases.query: SELECT h.region, approx_percentile_cont(f.bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows f JOIN hosts h ON f.dst = h.host WHERE f.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY h.region

cases.name: p_hist_whole
cases.query: histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le) (rate(m_bucket[5m])))

cases.name: p_job_undeclared_whole
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, m)

cases.name: p_labelrep_qot_whole
cases.query: max(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]), "job", "all", "", ""))

cases.name: p_labelrep_whole
cases.query: quantile by (x) (0.5, label_replace(m, "x", "$1", "job", "(.*)"))

cases.name: p_le_whole
cases.query: quantile by (le) (0.5, m)

cases.name: s3_src
cases.query: SELECT src, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src

cases.name: d_distinct
cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT src, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src

cases.name: g_expr
cases.query: SELECT src || dst AS k, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src || dst

cases.name: g_two
cases.query: SELECT src, dst, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src, dst

cases.name: g_two_nowin
cases.query: SELECT src, dst, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows GROUP BY src, dst

cases.name: h_having
cases.query: SELECT dst, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY dst HAVING count(*) > 1

cases.name: j_full
cases.query: SELECT f.src, h.region, approx_percentile_cont(f.bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows f FULL JOIN hosts h ON f.dst = h.host WHERE f.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY f.src, h.region

cases.name: j_left
cases.query: SELECT h.region, approx_percentile_cont(f.bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows f LEFT JOIN hosts h ON f.dst = h.host WHERE f.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY h.region

cases.name: j_self_cross
cases.query: SELECT a.src, b.dst, approx_percentile_cont(a.bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows a JOIN flows b ON a.src = b.src WHERE a.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND b.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY a.src, b.dst

cases.name: j_three
cases.query: SELECT a.src, b.src AS s2, c.region, approx_percentile_cont(a.bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows a JOIN flows b ON a.dst = b.dst JOIN hosts c ON b.dst = c.host WHERE a.ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY a.src, b.src, c.region

cases.name: l_limit_over
cases.query: SELECT dst, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY dst ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 5

cases.name: l_limit_under
cases.query: SELECT dst, approx_percentile_cont(b, 0.9) AS q FROM (SELECT dst, bytes AS b FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' LIMIT 10) t GROUP BY dst

cases.name: p_and_on
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, a and on(job) b)

cases.name: p_cv_by
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, count_values by (job) ("v", m))

cases.name: p_cv_key
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, count_values("job", m))

cases.name: p_few_series
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, m)

cases.name: p_gl_diff
cases.query: quantile by (job, instance) (0.5, a * on(x) group_left(instance) b)

cases.name: p_gl_same
cases.query: quantile by (job, instance) (0.5, m{side="l"} * on(x) group_left(instance) m{side="r"})

cases.name: p_gl_same_offset
cases.query: quantile by (job, instance) (0.5, m * on(x) group_left(instance) m offset 1h)

cases.name: p_gr_same
cases.query: quantile by (job, instance) (0.5, m{side="l"} * on(x) group_right(job) m{side="r"})

cases.name: p_hist
cases.query: histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le, job) (rate(m_bucket[5m])))

cases.name: p_hist_qot
cases.query: quantile by (le) (0.5, rate(m_bucket[5m]))

cases.name: p_ignoring_arith
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, a + ignoring(side) b)

cases.name: p_labelrep_other
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, label_replace(m, "x", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))

cases.name: p_labelrep_same
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, label_replace(m, "job", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))

cases.name: p_or_diff
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, a or b)

cases.name: p_or_same
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, m{side="l"} or m{side="r"})

cases.name: p_qby_job
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, m)

cases.name: p_qby_job_inst
cases.query: quantile by (job, instance) (0.5, m)

cases.name: p_subq
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, max_over_time(m[30m:1m]))

cases.name: p_subq_outer
cases.query: max_over_time(quantile by (job) (0.5, m)[30m:1m])

cases.name: p_sum_by_job
cases.query: sum by (job) (quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]))

cases.name: p_sum_or_qot
cases.query: sum by (job) (quantile_over_time(0.9, a[5m]) or quantile_over_time(0.9, b[5m]))

cases.name: p_topk_by
cases.query: topk by (job) (3, quantile_over_time(0.9, m[5m]))

cases.name: p_unless
cases.query: quantile by (job) (0.5, a unless ignoring(instance) b)

cases.name: r_bytes_interval
cases.query: SELECT bytes, approx_percentile_cont(p, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY bytes

cases.name: r_bytes_no_rows
cases.query: SELECT bytes, approx_percentile_cont(p, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY bytes

cases.name: r_dst_interval_small
cases.query: SELECT dst, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY dst

cases.name: t_cd_by_src
cases.query: SELECT src, count(DISTINCT dst) AS c FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src

cases.name: t_topk_count
cases.query: SELECT dst, count(*) AS c FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY dst ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 3

cases.name: t_topk_sum
cases.query: SELECT dst, sum(bytes) AS c FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY dst ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 3

cases.name: u_outer_union
cases.query: SELECT src, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src UNION ALL SELECT dst, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY dst

cases.name: u_union_mixed
cases.query: SELECT k, approx_percentile_cont(b, 0.9) AS q FROM (SELECT src AS k, bytes AS b FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT dst AS k, bytes AS b FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes') t GROUP BY k

cases.name: u_union_same
cases.query: SELECT k, approx_percentile_cont(b, 0.9) AS q FROM (SELECT src AS k, bytes AS b FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND p > 1 UNION ALL SELECT src AS k, bytes AS b FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND p <= 1) t GROUP BY k

cases.name: w_window
cases.query: SELECT src, approx_percentile_cont(bytes, 0.9) AS q, rank() OVER (ORDER BY src) AS r FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY src

cases.name: w_window_key
cases.query: SELECT r, approx_percentile_cont(b, 0.9) AS q FROM (SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS r, bytes AS b FROM flows WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes') t GROUP BY r
